environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) in VPC subnet-0e5f6a7b with S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0x9y8z7w6v). Endpoint policy document restricts PutObject operations with condition key s3:content-type-starts-with requiring value to match image/ or application/pdf. The endpoint policy uses aws:PrincipalOrgID condition to scope to the organization AND includes a StringNotLike condition on s3:prefix denying any key containing executable extensions (.html, .htm, .js, .svg, .xml, .php, .jsp, .exe, .sh, .bat). Route table rtb-0m1n2o3p only has the vpce prefix list route for S3 (no NAT/IGW route to S3 CIDR ranges). Instance security group sg-0q4r5s6t has no outbound rules to S3 public IP ranges.

config.subnet: subnet-0e5f6a7b (private, no NAT route for S3 prefixes)
config.route_table: rtb-0m1n2o3p: S3 prefix list -> vpce-0x9y8z7w6v (no alternate S3 route)
config.security_group: sg-0q4r5s6t: no outbound to S3 public CIDR
